name: Transloader
description: High-speed multi-connection direct cloud file transloader with zero torrents for 100% Heroku TOS compliance.

MAX_CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS.description: Maximum number of downloads running simultaneously.

FILE_RETENTION_HOURS.description: Hours to retain files in ephemeral disk cache before automatic purge (default: 6).

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth password to protect your Transloader from unauthorized use.

AUTO_INSTALL_YTDLP.description: Automatically download static yt-dlp binary if not present for media link extraction.
